### If I earn $40 an hour, what's my annual take-home pay?
At $40 per hour over a standard 38-hour week (1,976 hours per year), gross annual income is approximately $79,040. Wage Calculator estimates income tax of $14,232 and Medicare Levy of $1,581 for the current financial year, leaving a net take-home of roughly $63,227 per year — about $32 per hour after tax.
